name: kimi-skin
description: 可恢复、低侵入的 Kimi 桌面端自定义主题 harness（非官方实验项目）
author: kimi-skin contributors

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js && mkdir -p dist/compatibility && cp src/compatibility/*.json dist/compatibility/
scripts.release:pack: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build && bash scripts/package-release.sh
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build
